result.summary: The page is mostly visually consistent, but there are a couple of layout issues: one restaurant card is clipped on the right edge in the horizontal row, and the next content card is partially hidden behind the fixed bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" row, the rightmost restaurant card is cut off at the screen edge, with its image and title partially visible only.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the carousel spacing or viewport padding so cards are either fully visible or clearly presented as scrollable without awkward clipping.

issues.description: The restaurant card below "Popular right now" is partially obscured by the bottom navigation bar, making part of the content inaccessible in view.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so the last card clears the fixed navigation bar.
